thread:
sophia: quick check — running perf microbench for private VPC vs hosted for gpt-medium-latest. seeing ~12-18% p95 regression on tokens/sec in private cluster. anyone else seeing this? :thinking:
kevin: assign me. can you paste the bench cmd and deps?
sophia: bench command: `./tools/bench_infer.sh --model gpt-medium-latest --seq 512 --batch 1 --iters 200 --quant none` on both envs. env diffs: private uses CUDA 12.1, driver 535.98; hosted uses CUDA 12.0, driver 534.x
raj: any differences in kernel or NUMA settings? private nodes are 2-socket Ampere with ACPI cpufreq.
sophia: kernel private: 6.6.12, hosted: 6.5.8. NUMA config is same afaik. I/O MTU is 9000 on both.
bench-bot: perf-summary: p50 hosted=46.2 tok/s p95=43.1 tok/s; private p50=40.5 p95=35.9 tok/s
kevin: interesting — p95 drop larger than p50. maybe KV cache refill or small-thread stalls. can you run with --debug-mode perf and capture nvprof/cupy traces?
sophia: running nvprof now. also will run with `GOMP_CPU_AFFINITY=0-23` pinned cores and `KMP_AFFINITY=compact`. will report back.
leah: fwiw we had a similar regression when THP was enabled on onprem. check `cat /sys/kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/enabled`
sophia: confirmed: private had [always] while hosted shows [never]
raj: ok that could explain bigger tail latencies. try disabling THP and re-run.
sophia: disabled THP and re-ran bench. new numbers: p50=45.1 p95=42.0 — much closer. looks like THP was main culprit. :relieved:
kevin: nice. add to runbook: ensure THP=never on private deploys for inference nodes. also add check in bootstrap scripts.
leah: also add a test in our perf CI that compares p95 within 10% vs baseline.
sophia: I'll open a diffs PR with systemctl drop-in and CI job. ETA EOD.
raj: tagging infra and ops for rollout: @infra-team @ops
sophia: thanks all. attaching nvprof logs to the PR. bench-bot: mark resolved
bench-bot: thread-mark: resolved
